From Deekay

My life used to be business suits and boardrooms.

Six-figure salary. Business class flights. Five-star hotels. From the outside, it looked like I had everything figured out.

What it didn't show were the missed birthdays. The weekends that belonged to my company. That quiet, persistent feeling that something important was passing me by.

In 2017, I started looking for a way out. Trading seemed perfect: no boss, minimal startup costs, income with no ceiling. The early wins felt amazing... until they weren't. I lost real money overtrading. I wasted years jumping from strategy to strategy, hoping the next one would finally be the answer.

Then I went deep on one approach. I obsessed over it until everything unnecessary fell away. One setup. One execution. Walk away. That framework eventually brought me to consistent $1K daily targets, and my best single session hit 5 figures in just 30 minutes.

2017Started trading
$1KDaily target
5 figsBest 30-min session
1Setup. That's it.

But here's what changed everything for me.

I stopped trading my own money.

Most people don't know this, but there are billion-dollar companies whose entire business model is finding ordinary people, funding them with capital to trade, and splitting the profits.

You trade

Their money.

If you lose

They absorb it. Nothing gets clawed back from you.

If you win

You keep the majority of what you make.

No personal savings at risk. No finance background required.

That's the model I'm teaching in this free masterclass. And it's available to anyone, including complete beginners who've never placed a single trade.

Inside the masterclass

What I'll Cover In This Masterclass

01

The Wisest Way to Trade in 2026

Even as a veteran trader, we're all exposed to market drawdowns. I'll show you why using large companies' capital, instead of your own, is simply the smarter way to trade in today's market. And how ordinary people from their own homes are doing this right now.

02

What It Actually Takes to Get Funded

Not everyone automatically gets handed an account. There's an evaluation process, and I'll walk you through exactly how to pass it. It's more straightforward than you think, and I'll show you what these companies are actually looking for.

03

From Zero to Your First Funded Account

No experience? No problem. I started from scratch too, and made plenty of expensive mistakes along the way so you don't have to. I'll show you a clear path that works even if you've never traded a single day in your life.

Meet your host

I'm Trader Deekay.

I'm 38, based in Singapore, and I haven't had a 9-5 in 4 years.

I spent years in a corporate career that paid well but cost me everything that actually mattered. I started trading in 2017, made all the classic mistakes, and eventually built a framework that gave me consistent daily profits trading just 30-60 minutes a night.

In 2022, my child's medical condition made the decision for me. I resigned and went all in. What felt like jumping off a cliff quickly became the best thing I ever did. Now my workday ends when the kids go to bed, and starts right after.

I share all of this not because I have to. But because financial freedom shouldn't require sacrificing your best years. Or your family. Or the moments you can never get back.
